about:
Honolulu Furniture Company was founded in 2008 by German furniture maker Thorben Wuttke in Honolulu, Hawaii. Operating from a studio on Cummins Street in the Kakaako district, the company began as a woodworking practice focused on custom-built pieces for local clients.

The shop produces custom furniture, cabinetry, and heirloom refinishing for residential and commercial projects. Each piece is built in-house using wood and finished with a two-part acrylic polyurethane coating for durability. The studio handles projects from concept through fabrication, with a typical turnaround of eight to ten weeks.

The company serves homeowners, architects, interior designers, and businesses across Oahu. Its client base includes both private residences and commercial spaces, with the team collaborating directly with design professionals to realize specific visions.

Wuttke positions the operation as a manufacturer rather than a retailer, emphasizing a tailored approach and craftsmanship intended to last generations. The business was started to provide a direct, local alternative to mass-produced furniture, offering close collaboration and attention to detail on every project.
